node_schema.label: human-readable node name
node_schema.implementation: implementation intent, inputs, outputs, skills and infrastructure
node_schema.requirements: knowledge, materials, equipment and skills commonly needed
node_schema.evidence_types: types of evidence that can substantiate the node
node_schema.implementation_contexts: contexts where the node may be implemented
node_schema.risk_profile: known or typical implementation hazards and controls
